meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Cleans up cookie banners, ads and app prompts on Goodreads
meta.notes: **Live check (2026-11-13).** Checked `https://www.goodreads.com/` in logged-out desktop Chromium at 1512×862. `.googleBannerAd#div-gpt-ad-goodr-home-top-300x250` matched a 300×250 Google ad slot visible in the viewport. No visible cookie or app banner was found. `recipes/fixtures/goodreads/desktop-real.html` is a sanitized excerpt of the observed ad slot; dynamic ad contents are omitted. Cookie and app selectors remain generic and are not verified for this site.
